text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, my challenge in the Senior division
together with Agnes Tachyon begins.
Today, I went on a New Year's shrine visit, partly to make a wish.

I haven't told Agnes Tachyon yet,
but this year, I want to take an aggressive rotation aiming to conquer the middle-distance GIs and the Grand Prix.
choice_data_list: (If only I can help her surpass her limits...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What were you praying for so earnestly?
I was planning to tell you at the upcoming meeting, but this is good timing. I explained the contents of my earlier prayer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, to think you'd conquer
both the middle-distance GⅠ and the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai, then the Takarazuka Kinen, and in the autumn, the Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're quite greedy, Guinea Pig-kun.
Aren't you overestimating this so-called 'God'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More to the point, I haven't heard
anything about this rotation yet.
choice_data_list: (Is there a chance I'll get turned down?)

text_block_list.text: ...And just as I braced myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Well, that'll do! Not bad at all!"
Agnes Tachyon flashed a grin.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Now that Plan A has succeeded,
we must stay on the offensive this year, lest all our hard work go down the drain!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I will excel in all of them. I promise you.
Consider your wish as good as granted already.

Agnes Tachyon's casual declaration
brings back memories of New Year's Day a year ago.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What's this? The "Classic Triple Crown"?
"This is our goal for this year—yours and mine."
"This is our goal for this year."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I believe I've told you before that there's no guarantee you'll be able to run.
Considering how things were back then, that's an unbelievable response.
choice_data_list: You've changed too, haven't you, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why get so sentimental? Hundreds of billions
of cells die every single day. Change is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, well.
I can kind of understand what you're trying to say."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Last year was a turbulent one filled with endings and fresh starts.
It truly was a memorable year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Last year is last year. It's in the past.
Now that our New Year's shrine visit is done, let's head home without delay.
choice_data_list: Do you have research to do?
Do you have research to do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, it's training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Since our policies have finally aligned,
let us tackle this with enthusiasm."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Not bad, right?
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, let's take it easy.
Time to train when we get back!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing, huh.
Hmm, that's somewhat unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still, spending the New Year just lounging in bed isn't so bad once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, want to try buying a hammock
at the New Year's sale?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you not know? The swaying of a hammock
is scientifically proven to relieve stress.

Afterward, the two of us bought a hammock
at the home improvement store... and took a nap.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Zzz...
At any rate, it looks like it's going to be a busy year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An omikuji, huh?
Unexpected, but fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If mere words on paper can alter my guinea pig's
mental state, that would be quite intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While we're at it,
would you let me examine just how devout of a believer you are?

I politely declined her investigation.
...At any rate, it looks like it's going to be a busy year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"There is plenty to be done.
If last year was a year of endings and fresh starts—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This year will be a year of great leaps forward!

I gave a firm nod in response to her smile.
Looks like this year is going to be a busy one!
